notes:
ONE ACCOUNT'S DATA NO LONGER FOLLOWS YOU INTO ANOTHER.

Signing out dropped you to a signed-out session and deliberately left everything on the device, so that signing in later could carry your work up with you. Nothing recorded WHOSE work it was. Sign out of one account and into a different one and the first account's notes, inventory, crafting projects, ship loadouts and haul runs were handed to the second - written to the cloud, not held in a cache, which is why signing out again or clearing the browser did not undo it.

The device now records which account its data belongs to. Data left by an account is cleared before a different one loads; data from a signed-out session is still carried up when you sign in, because that is the part worth keeping.

Two other paths went the same way and are closed too: payouts and refinery orders that failed to upload were retried under whoever signed in next, and anything still waiting in the save queue is now published before you sign out rather than discarded with the rest.

SIGNING OUT NOW ASKS FIRST, and says what it does: your notes, inventory and ops leave the device, and come back when you sign in. Your usage-data and price-sharing choices are NOT cleared - they are answers about you, not about an account.

IF YOU HAVE SWITCHED ACCOUNTS ON ONE DEVICE, this does not repair what already crossed over; there is no history to roll back to. It stops it happening again. Check whether the account looks right, and say so if it does not.

DATA. No Star Citizen data changed in this build.
